facts.value: Defines shared Kirby Ca/Gn copied-neutral-special fresh entries and eight motion callbacks: animation-completion dispatch, empty grounded IASA, command-consumed angled aerial x/y velocity replacement, event-driven effect creation/latching or destruction/reset, command-selected aerial physics, and collision-driven Ca/Gn state-change calls forwarding the current animation frame. Active Ca and Gn motion-table entries share all eight callbacks. Player-facing move names, compiled section/ABI layout, complete collision predicates and full state-change flag semantics remain unresolved.
facts.rationale: Independent complete canonical/rendered review and active callback consumers verify shared functionality without numeric-enum gameplay inference.

evidence.why: Active Gn consumers share all eight callbacks.

facts.value: For the shared Ca/Gn aerial states, consumes a nonzero cmd_vars[0] and replaces x/y self velocity with attribute-configured sine/cosine projections derived from vertical stick input and facing. This is one operation per raised command, not an additive impulse or necessarily once per entire move. Valid ordinary attributes produce a dead-zone and saturated signed launch angle; invalid or exceptional values are not validated.
facts.rationale: Repairs ambiguous impulse and one-shot wording and includes independently verified Gn use.

facts.value: If cmd_vars[0] is nonzero, clear it before arithmetic. Read vertical left-stick input; conditionally negate it for magnitude, cap at specialn_ca_y_axis_range, subtract specialn_ca_x_axis_range, floor negative range to zero and restore negative input sign. Convert range*specialn_ca_angle_difference/(outer-inner) from degrees to radians. Overwrite self_vel.y with forward_momentum*sinf(angle) and self_vel.x with forward_momentum*(facing_dir*cosf(angle)); z and facing are unchanged. Zero command makes no velocity writes. There is no validation of range ordering, zero denominator, nonfinite values, overflow or facing normalization.
facts.rationale: Supersedes whole-vector replacement and incorrect ordering; preserves actual arithmetic grouping and exceptional-input limits.

evidence.why: Complete input, arithmetic, command and velocity flow.

facts.value: Services throw_flags_b1 events in the shared Ca/Gn grounded physics callback, creating/latching a hat-selected effect when the latch is clear or invoking effect destruction and latch reset when set, then unconditionally delegates to ft_80084FA8. An unsupported hat latches without spawning. The event producer and exact delegated movement internals remain unresolved.
facts.rationale: Repairs baseline update wording and avoids claiming independently unverified producer origin.

facts.value: Consumes throw_flags_b1. On that event with x2219_b0 clear, Captain/Ganon spawn synchronized effects 1195/1203 using the GObj and parts[0]/parts[44] joints; other hats spawn nothing. All hat branches then set x2219_b0 true without checking a spawn result. With the latch set, pass the GObj to ftCommon_8007DB24, which clears the latch and calls efLib_DestroyAll. Finally forward the GObj to ft_80084FA8 unconditionally; no effect handle or ownership transfer is stored locally.
facts.rationale: Completes default branch, effect arguments and actual destructive helper data flow.

facts.value: Without a pending throw_flags_b1 event, skip local effect handling. Consume each pending event: a clear x2219_b0 takes hat-dependent spawn selection then becomes true even for unsupported hats; an already-true latch is cleared by ftCommon_8007DB24, which calls efLib_DestroyAll. Successive events can alternate creation/latching and destruction/reset, subject to external state changes. Always call ft_80084FA8 afterward. The latch is not proof of successful effect creation.
facts.rationale: Supersedes incomplete first/later-event behavior and active-effect assumption.

facts.value: Services throw_flags_b1 events in shared Ca/Gn aerial physics: clear latch selects hat-dependent effect creation then latching, while set latch invokes destruction/reset. It then dispatches cmd_vars[1] to two delegated movement helpers or repeated x/y scaling. Unsupported hats can latch without spawning, and unsupported command values make no movement-switch operation. Exact event producer and delegated movement internals remain unresolved.
facts.rationale: Replaces effect-update rationale with verified destruction/reset and complete optional branches.

facts.value: Consumes throw_flags_b1 and reads x2219_b0 and hat kind. A clear latch selects Captain/Ganon effect 1195/1203 using parts 0 and 44 joints; other hats spawn nothing, but all branches set the latch. A set latch invokes ftCommon_8007DB24, clearing the latch and calling efLib_DestroyAll. Then cmd_vars[1] 0 calls ft_80084EEC, 1 multiplies self_vel.y and self_vel.x by specialn_ca_additional_vertical_momentum, and 2 calls ft_80084DB0. Other values make no movement-switch operation. cmd_vars[1] is not consumed; no local z assignment exists.
facts.rationale: Corrects vector scope, effect-state assumptions and omitted defaults.

evidence.why: All field reads/writes and command cases.

facts.value: Each pending throw_flags_b1 event is consumed. A clear effect latch becomes true after hat-dependent spawn selection, including the no-spawn default; an already-set latch is cleared and effect destruction invoked through ftCommon_8007DB24. Movement then uses cmd_vars[1]: 0 delegates to ft_80084EEC, 1 repeatedly scales x/y self velocity, 2 delegates to ft_80084DB0, otherwise no movement-switch operation. Case 1 is not inherently damping: zero, negative, >1, infinite and NaN multipliers are not rejected. The command remains set until another writer changes it.
facts.rationale: Completes event/default behavior, repeated scaling and exceptional multiplier boundaries.
